key: I worked real hard to get up here because a friend told me they were getting stoned here.
en: I worked real hard to get up here because a friend told me they were getting stoned here.
ja: 友達に「ここでラリれるらしい」って聞いて、頑張って登ってきたんだけど。
どうやら、勘違いだったみたいだ。

key: Ever since I hustled to come here by mistake, I've found a really great passion for helping people.
en: Ever since I hustled to come here by mistake, I've found a really great passion for helping people.
ja: 間違えてここに来て以来、人を助けることにすごくやりがいを感じるようになったんだ。

key: And there's been no better time to do it, what with the city's reconstruction.
en: And there's been no better time to do it, what with the city's reconstruction.
ja: それに、街の復興が進んでる今ほど、それをやるのにいいタイミングはないよね。

key: Guess who patched up this place's foundation. That's right, lookin' at 'im.
en: Guess who patched up this place's foundation.  That's right, lookin' at 'im.
ja: この場所の土台を直したのが誰か、当ててみてよ。そう、俺だよ。

key: Whaaaat, are the TMs really still higher up? That's no fair!
en: Whaaaat, are the TMs really still higher up? That's no fair!
ja: マジかよ、わざマシンってまだ上の階にあるの? そりゃないよ!

key: This is the ninth floor: Evolution Stones and Special II.
en: This is the ninth floor: Evolution Stones and Special II.
ja: ここは9階、進化の石と特殊アイテムIIのフロアだ。
